reels.counter_belief: Practise on a demo account for a few months first.
reels.claim: Demo practice is slow (100 trades ≈ 3 months) and shows only one kind of market; a backtest shows 5 years in a weekend.

و آخرش… عددها حقیقت رو می‌گن.

reels.counter_belief: Look for a strategy with a high win rate.
reels.claim: Expectancy, not win rate, decides profit; the profitable low-win-rate strategy brings losing streaks you must have seen in a backtest to stick with it.

reels.counter_belief: When a strategy fails, learn a better one.
reels.claim: 20 trades are mostly luck: the same 50% strategy reads 30–70%. Only hundreds of trades show the truth; a backtest gets there in a weekend.

reels.counter_belief: If your strategy is profitable, you will make money.
reels.claim: Risk per trade decides the outcome: the same profitable trades end +46% at 1% risk and −51% at 30%. Pick the risk whose worst day (seen in a backtest) you can survive.
